results.rationale: Consistency: The fork, folded tissue, white background and overall arrangement remain, with a small change to the plate rim contour/shading. Instruction: A new black-handled serrated implement crosses the tissue and plate while the original right-hand knife remains. The expected result is the existing knife resting on the tissue; adding a different implement only weakly addresses this, so major omission. Quality: Background, plate and fabric are coherent, but the diagonal implement has an unnatural blade-to-second-metal-handle transition and confused utensil geometry, a clear structural artifact.

Consistency: The diagonal tissue becomes a broad rectangular cloth, a second folded tissue is added over the plate, and the left fork shifts; the white background remains. Instruction: The right-hand knife disappears and a horizontal fork appears on the new tissue. The expected edit places the knife on the tissue; a fork is the wrong utensil, so the instruction is not fulfilled. Quality: The plate, two forks and folded textiles have coherent shapes, plausible reflections, fabric folds and shadows; no noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: The fork is removed, the plate is enlarged and shifted, and the tissue outline shifts left; the white setting is retained. Instruction: The right-hand silver knife is relocated diagonally onto the tissue with its blade and handle supported there, matching the requested placement. Quality: The plate, cloth and silver knife are otherwise coherent with natural shadows and reflections, but a small dark spike projects beside the blade tip.

Consistency: The fork rotates and becomes partly hidden beneath the plate, the tissue shifts right, and the plate contour/position changes; the white background remains. Instruction: The knife moves from the right to a diagonal position across the plate. It should rest on the tissue, but nearly all of it rests over the plate, so the requested placement is poorly implemented. Quality: The utensils and plate have coherent shapes and perspective; metallic reflections, cloth folds and cast shadows appear natural, without noticeable artifacts.
